about: Q.0 answerability set. 40 questions. expect = any-of substrings (case-insensitive); range = any number in the answer body within [lo, hi] after normalization (thousands separators, decimals, 'million'/'billion'); compare items are scored per item from the sentences that name the item. holdout=true rows are NOT run unless --holdout (run once at the end, never tuned on). Memory rows run 'setup' first in the same project.
